name: Band Seated Shoulder Press
steps: Sit tall on a bench with both feet pinning the middle of a resistance band and hold an end beside each shoulder.
Brace your abs, set your wrists straight above your elbows, and keep your chest lifted.
Press both hands straight overhead until your arms extend alongside your ears.
Lower your hands slowly back to shoulder height while resisting the band's pull.
tips: Keep your rib cage down so your lower back does not arch as you press overhead.
Keep your elbows slightly ahead of your shoulders rather than flaring straight back.
